$comment: The parity adapter's map (protocol v9 addendum §3). selectors: literal rewrites applied to every selector the smoke body passes to $, $$ and txt (a match must not touch a letter, digit, - or _ on either side), in order. aliases: before every $, $$ and txt call and every step, each element matching ui gets the mockup attribute it lacks, from one of its UI attributes through values (a value map; unmapped values pass through), transform (a named adapter function) or constant; so mockup selectors and dataset reads ([data-bv=fin], .dataset.p) work unchanged. helpers: where each prelude name comes from: adapter (test/parity/adapter.ts), prelude (smoke.mjs's own definition, re-evaluated over the adapter's $), or a UI counterpart. unmapped: mockup controls deliberately left without a UI selector, and why. internals: mockup internals and what stands for them in the UI; null means the UI has no counterpart yet, so the checks that need them stay pending-slice.

selectors.why: one #pane shows the current tab; this matches it only while Dashboard is open, as the mockup's #dash is the hidden pane otherwise
the top bar's period button; the frozen mockup moved its arrows into the popover, the UI still has S0's arrows beside it
the UI's accessible name adds the month: Gross by day, Nov 2026

aliases.why: the mockup's month strip keys a month by its 0-based index (data-dm=5 is Jun); the UI by its period (2026-06)
the mockup's year and quarter strips key a period as 2026 or 2026Q3; the UI as 2026 or 2026-Q3

helpers.$: adapter: querySelector over the rewritten selector
helpers.$$: adapter: querySelectorAll over the rewritten selector
helpers.txt: adapter: the rewritten selector's text, whitespace collapsed
helpers.errs: adapter: console.error calls and window error events while the body runs
helpers.__m: uiSource: [, the text of every src/** .ts and .tsx file], the UI's counterpart of the mockup's inline script

internals.style: themeCss: the first <style> of the document holds src/theme.css, minified the way the mockup writes its stylesheet (no spaces around { } : ; , and no ; before })

unmapped.#kview: the frozen mockup's View as button (#kview, its popover #kvp with [data-bv] options, exit #vax): the UI has no View as yet (S7). The UI's static scope note and its Dashboard-local 'View books as' switch are the obsolete S1 vocabulary and are deliberately not mapped onto it.
unmapped.#pp: the frozen mockup's period popover (presets [data-pk], booking ranges [data-bp]): S7's single period control; the UI's S0 popover has other contents
